frontmatter.title: The 'Pull Request Nightmare': How RCE Was Found in Google & Microsoft Repos
frontmatter.subheading: A deep dive into the critical security flaw discovered by Orca Security (roin-orca) and how it turned simple PRs into critical threats.
frontmatter.excerpt: Explore the `pull_request_target` vulnerability found by Orca Security. See how Fortune-100 companies were exposed to RCE from a single malicious pull request.
